bios.label: Long
bios.text:
Nivedkrishna Thavarayil is a creative strategist and director based in New York and New Jersey. He builds campaigns people stop scrolling for, organic and paid, then directs the series that keep them watching.

He has directed more than twelve short-form series for Canvas, including Face Value, a micro-documentary about a makeup artist's road to New York Fashion Week, along with Red Flags, Dear NYC, Taser Fight Championship and Demo Day, shot across New York, Boston, Baltimore, San Francisco and Los Angeles. Through Thava Studio he has grown more than twenty brands, from restaurants to creators.

Before New York, he worked in creative strategy at the meme marketing agency WLDD in Bangalore, where his work included The Pope's Exorcist cinema stunt for Sony Pictures India and Thank You Durex. He trained in directing at the New York Film Academy's one-year filmmaking conservatory, where he made the Dean's List. He plans shoots in Directure AI and produces with a Claude Code pipeline connected to Premiere Pro, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, and every output still goes through a human edit.

Around all of that, he co-founded Growvior Software, a software and AI product company accepted into the Google for Startups Cloud Program. He hosts Unscripted, a podcast narrated in his own voice clone. He was director of photography on Love Is Stronger Than Hate, winner of Best Costume Design at the Follow Your Heart Film Festival in Miami. And he runs @f24foster, a community of more than 7,000 film lovers.

disciplines: {series}+ short-form series for [Canvas](https://www.canvasott.com), micro dramas and micro-documentaries shot in New York, Boston, Baltimore, San Francisco and Los Angeles. Before that, 20+ short films at the New York Film Academy.

50+ campaigns at [WLDD](/work/fifteen-people-on-one-floor/) for Sony Pictures India, Netflix India, Prime Video and Zomato, including [The Pope's Exorcist](/work/the-popes-exorcist/) cinema stunt. Organic and paid social, creator partnerships and performance creative.

Wrote and directed [Dear NYC](/series/dear-nyc/) and the shorts [Frames of Silence](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4IGrik_Qho), [The Last Pizza](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3YfriOGVA4w) and [Unspoken Distance](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EcSJKrXuJfM).

Edits his own films. Director of photography on [Love Is Stronger Than Hate](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VQRsfpHgC38), winner of Best Costume Design at the Follow Your Heart Film Festival, Miami 2026. Shoots client content himself, like the [Frangos](/work/frangos-world-cup/) dishes, on his own Sony.
Runs Thava Studio in New York: 20+ brands grown, from [Frangos Peri-Peri](/work/frangos-world-cup/) to the AI app [Fetchy](/work/fetchy/).

Co-founded [Growvior Software](https://growvior.com) with [Agrajh AK](https://www.linkedin.com/in/agrajh-ak/) in 2025: AI products, SaaS platforms and apps, including Mockits AI. Accepted into the [Google for Startups Cloud Program](https://www.instagram.com/growvior/p/DVLRPeVDsg1/).

Plans shoots in [Directure AI](https://directureai.com) and runs a Claude Code pipeline wired into Premiere Pro, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs. Every output still goes through a human edit. Read [how a micro drama gets planned in a day](/work/how-we-plan-a-micro-drama-in-a-day/).
[Unscripted](/podcast/): {eps} episodes, every article on this site read in his own ElevenLabs voice clone, on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube.

Runs [@f24foster](https://www.instagram.com/f24foster/), a community of 7,000+ film lovers. Reviews films on [Letterboxd](https://letterboxd.com/nivedkrishna/) and shoots street photography around New York.
